author: Huawei
description:
At #HUAWEICONNECT 2026, #Huawei unveiled #UnifiedBus, a new computing architecture designed to address the communication bottlenecks of #AgenticAI and support the growing demand for AI compute.
 
As AI agents interact with models hundreds of times per hour, traditional clusters can face communication bottlenecks, with compute utilization dropping to around 20% at 100,000-NPU scale.
 
#UnifiedBus tackles these challenges with four key features:
• Unified protocol & memory semantics — enabling faster data movement and lower latency
• Heterogeneous compute collaboration — enabling flexible CPU-NPU ratios for different AI workloads
• Tiered storage & global pooling — expanding memory capacity to support KV cache
• Optoelectronic interconnect & flexible networking — enabling elastic scaling from a single cabinet to million-NPU clusters

title: Huawei UnifiedBus Powers a New Era of Scalable AI Computing
